title: Local Existence and Finite-Time Singularity Formation in the Vlasov-Poisson-Isotropic Landau System
summary: The isotropic Landau (Coulomb) operator was introduced in kinetic theory by Krieger and Strain (Comm. Partial Differential Equations, 2012). In this work, we study the spatially inhomogeneous Vlasov--Poisson--isotropic Landau system. We first establish a local--in--time existence theory for the Cauchy problem: for initial data satisfying a suitable smallness condition in an appropriate norm, there exists a non--negative solution on a time interval $[0,T]$, where the lifespan $T$ depends on the size of the initial data.
